description: Source code for a Sphinx extension that enhances documentation generation for Cython modules, including custom autodoc classes and callback functions for processing docstrings and signatures.

classes.name: CythonMethodDocumenter
classes.description: Custom autodoc class for documenting Cython methods with a specific priority.

methods.name: is_cython_extension
methods.description: Determines if a given object is a Cython extension based on its docstring and attributes.

methods.name: callback_docstring
methods.description: Processes and modifies the docstring lines during autodoc generation, especially for Cython extensions.

methods.name: callback_signature
methods.description: Adjusts the signature display for Cython classes by removing 'self' and formatting the docstring.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the Sphinx extension, adding custom lexer and autodocumenter, and connecting processing callbacks.
